definition: To let something happen or let someone do something
example_sentence: The new rules allow students to submit their work online.

definition: To accept that something is true
example_sentence: Many scientists believe that the climate is changing faster than expected.

definition: To stay in the same place or condition
example_sentence: Prices remained stable for most of the year.

definition: To put forward an idea, or to show that something is likely
example_sentence: The results suggest that sleep improves memory.

definition: To think that something will probably happen
example_sentence: Experts expect the population to grow over the next decade.

definition: To come after something, or to act according to instructions
example_sentence: A short discussion followed the lecture.

definition: To arrive at a place, level or goal
example_sentence: The team reached an agreement after long negotiations.

definition: To include something as a necessary part
example_sentence: The project involves collecting data from several hospitals.

definition: To keep doing something without stopping
example_sentence: Researchers continued the experiment for another month.

definition: To make something new exist
example_sentence: The program created hundreds of new jobs.

definition: To say you are willing to give something to someone
example_sentence: The university offers free courses to local residents.

definition: To decide which one you want from several possibilities
example_sentence: Students can choose between two research topics.

definition: To get something that someone gives or sends
example_sentence: Each participant received a small payment.

definition: To keep someone or something safe from harm
example_sentence: Helmets protect cyclists from serious head injuries.

definition: To stop something from happening
example_sentence: Washing hands helps prevent the spread of disease.

definition: To have the same opinion as someone else
example_sentence: Most experts agree that the plan is too expensive.

definition: To agree to take or believe something
example_sentence: The committee accepted the proposal without changes.

definition: To succeed in reaching a goal through effort
example_sentence: The school achieved its best results in ten years.

definition: To put something new in the place of something else
example_sentence: Machines have replaced many workers in factories.

definition: To have or use something together with others
example_sentence: The two countries share a long border.

definition: To be decided or affected by something else
example_sentence: The price depends on the size of the order.

definition: To be real or present
example_sentence: Life may exist on other planets.

definition: To not succeed in doing something
example_sentence: The first attempt to launch the satellite failed.

definition: To lift or increase something, or to bring up a question
example_sentence: The report raises serious questions about safety.

definition: To take something away from a place
example_sentence: Workers removed the old pipes from the building.

definition: To know someone or something from before, or to accept that something is true
example_sentence: The government recognized the need for reform.

definition: How much there is of something
example_sentence: Plants need a large amount of water in summer.

definition: Information and understanding gained through learning or experience
example_sentence: Scientific knowledge grows through careful observation.

definition: People living together in an organized community
example_sentence: Technology has changed modern society in many ways.

definition: The place or thing something comes from
example_sentence: The sun is the main source of energy on Earth.

definition: An increase in size, number or importance
example_sentence: The country saw rapid economic growth after the war.

definition: How much something is worth or how important it is
example_sentence: The value of the house doubled in ten years.

definition: The chance that something bad will happen
example_sentence: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.

definition: How often or how fast something happens, measured over time
example_sentence: The unemployment rate fell to four percent.

definition: All the people or animals living in a particular area
example_sentence: Half of the world's population lives in cities.

definition: A typical or important part of something
example_sentence: A key feature of the design is its low cost.

definition: How good or bad something is
example_sentence: The quality of the water has improved.

definition: Something that helps you be more successful than others
example_sentence: Speaking two languages is a clear advantage in the job market.

definition: The way a person or animal acts
example_sentence: The study examined the behavior of young children at play.

definition: A chance to do something good or useful
example_sentence: The program gives students an opportunity to work abroad.

definition: The ability to do something well, gained through practice
example_sentence: Reading is a skill that improves with practice.

definition: Able to be used or obtained
example_sentence: The full report is available on the website.

definition: Belonging to or relating to a particular area or community
example_sentence: The local council approved a new park near the river.

definition: Probably going to happen or be true
example_sentence: Prices are likely to rise next year.

definition: Needed in order to do or achieve something
example_sentence: More research is necessary before the drug can be approved.

definition: Happening or starting a short time ago
example_sentence: Recent studies have questioned this theory.

definition: Important and possibly dangerous or harmful
example_sentence: Air pollution is a serious threat to public health.

definition: Before now or before a particular time
example_sentence: By 1900, the city had already doubled in size.

definition: More than usual or more than others
example_sentence: The disease is dangerous, especially for older people.

definition: Possibly; used when something is not certain
example_sentence: Perhaps the most surprising result was the drop in crime.
